描述_EN: lacquer workers quickly realised the decorative potential of the material. lacquer is a waterproof varnish made from the sap of the tree rhus vernicifera. they coated the surface of vessels with multiple layers of lacquer and carved them with decorative patterns. here two pheasants are shown against a background of flowers. the chinese began to use it to provide a protective coating for wooden and bamboo bowls at least 3,000 years ago.
描述_ZN: 漆器工人很快意识到这种材料的装饰潜力。 漆是一种防水的清漆，是由树的汁液制成的，它是由Rhus vernicifera制成的。 他们在器皿的表面涂上多层漆，并在上面雕刻装饰性的图案。 这里显示的是两只野鸡，背景是鲜花。 中国人至少在3000年前就开始用它来为木碗和竹碗提供保护层。
